description: Rows and source families where research could not complete. These carry NO negative findings — tool exhaustion and access blocks are never recorded as absence.

blocked_source_families.family: UK Athletics / British Athletics National Championships venue rotation

evidence.note: Fetched: confirms Alexander Stadium, Birmingham as 2025 outdoor host (2-3 Aug 2025), returning after 2019.
Fetched: confirms Manchester Regional Arena as 2024 host (29-30 June 2024); decathlon/heptathlon at Alexander Stadium, 10,000m at Parliament Hill, London.

blocked_source_families.notes: The three rotating national outdoor/indoor championship venues identified — Alexander Stadium, Manchester Regional Arena, and Utilita Arena Birmingham (2025 British Indoor Championships) — are all already held in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt as CONFIRMED_1000_PLUS. The britishathletics.org.uk primary announcement article surfaced by search ('venues-confirmed-for-national-championships-in-2024-and-2025') returned HTTP 404 on fetch; Wikipedia championship-year pages were fetched as corroborating sources instead. Parliament Hill, London (used for one event, the 10,000m) is a small local track with no permanent stand and was excluded as immaterial. No venue outside the existing estate was surfaced by this family.

evidence.note: Fetched: capacity 4,953 (2,553 seated, 2,400 standing); home to Cardiff AAC and Welsh Athletics HQ.
Fetched: 8-lane 400m track, home club Wrexham Athletic Club; no spectator capacity figure given.

blocked_source_families.notes: The Welsh Athletics facility directory index (welshathletics.org/en/facility) is a client-side filter/search tool that returned no static venue list on fetch — a tool limitation, not evidence the directory is empty. The two facilities material to this package (Cardiff International Sports Stadium, already held in EXISTING-ESTATE.txt at 4,953; Queensway Stadium, a named target row) were reached via search and fetched individually. No other Welsh venue surfaced by any search as plausibly reaching 1,000 spectators.
